CREATE OR ALTER FUNCTION [utility].[GetFormattedFieldLookupValue] ( @Type varchar(25), @DisplayFormat nvarchar(250), @LookupObjectType varchar(25), @LookupObjectID int, @Value nvarchar(max) ) RETURNS nvarchar(max) AS BEGIN declare @formattedValue nvarchar(max)
if @Value is null begin return null end
if @LookupObjectType is null begin set @formattedValue = @Value
if @Type = 'Link' OR @Type = 'UncLink' begin SET @formattedValue = [utility].[GetFormattedFieldLinkValue](@Value); end end else begin if @LookupObjectType = 'ReferenceItemType' begin select @formattedValue = Name from AssetType where Objectid = @Value and [Object] = 'ReferenceItemType'; end else if @LookupObjectType = 'TaxonomyType' begin select @formattedValue = Name from AssetType where Objectid = @Value and [Object] = 'TaxonomyType'; end else begin declare @tokens table(ID int identity(1,1), Token nvarchar(100), Field nvarchar(100)) declare @fieldValues table(Field nvarchar(100), Value nvarchar(max), LookupObjectType nvarchar(250), LookupObjectID int, LookupDisplayFormat nvarchar(250), AllowMultipleValues bit) declare @fromPos int; declare @EndPos int; declare @ToPos int; declare @fieldlist nvarchar(4000); declare @valueint int;
set @valueint = TRY_CAST(@Value AS int)
if @valueint is null set @valueint = 0
set @fieldlist = '#'; set @formattedValue = @DisplayFormat
while patindex('%{%',@formattedValue) > 0 begin set @FromPos = patindex('%{%',@formattedValue); set @EndPos = PATINDEX('%}%', @formattedValue); if @EndPos = 0 set @EndPos = len(@formattedValue);
set @ToPos = @EndPos;
if @FromPos < @EndPos set @ToPos = @EndPos - @FromPos + 1;
declare @txt nvarchar(100) = SUBSTRING(@formattedValue, @FromPos, @ToPos) insert into @tokens Values (@txt, REPLACE(REPLACE(@txt,'{',''),'}','')) set @fieldlist = @fieldlist + lower(REPLACE(REPLACE(@txt,'{',''),'}','')) + '#'; set @formattedValue = replace(@formattedValue, @txt, '') end
insert into @fieldValues select distinct V.Name, V.Value, V.LookupObjectType, V.LookupObjectID, V.LookupDisplayFormat, V.AllowMultipleValues from ( SELECT IT.Name, COALESCE([IF].Value,[IF].FormattedValue) AS [Value], [IT].LookupObjectType, COALESCE([IT].LookupObjectID, 0) as LookupObjectID, [IT].LookupDisplayFormat, [IT].AllowMultipleValues FROM Field [IF] inner join FieldType IT ON [IF].FieldTypeID = IT.ID WHERE [IF].ObjectType = @LookupObjectType and [IF].ObjectID = @valueint and CHARINDEX(lower('#' + it.name + '#'),@fieldlist) > 0 ) V
if @LookupObjectType = 'Artifact' and (CHARINDEX('#id#',@fieldlist) > 0 or CHARINDEX('#textpath#',@fieldlist) > 0) begin insert into @fieldValues select distinct V.Name, V.Value, V.LookupObjectType, V.LookupObjectID, V.LookupDisplayFormat, V.AllowMultipleValues from ( SELECT P.FieldName as Name, p.FieldValue as Value, NULL as LookupObjectType, NULL as LookupObjectID, NULL as LookupDisplayFormat, cast(0 as bit) as AllowMultipleValues FROM ( SELECT A.ObjectID as AID, CAST(A.ObjectID as nvarchar(max)) as ID, CAST(TP.TextPath as nvarchar(max)) as TextPath FROM asset A cross apply dbo.GetAssetTextPathById(A.ID, '/') TP WHERE A.ObjectID = @valueint and A.[Object] = 'Artifact' ) A unpivot ( FieldValue for FieldName in (ID, TextPath) ) p ) V end else if @LookupObjectType = 'Taxonomy' and (CHARINDEX('#textpath#',@fieldlist) > 0) begin insert into @fieldValues select distinct V.Name, V.Value, V.LookupObjectType, V.LookupObjectID, V.LookupDisplayFormat, V.AllowMultipleValues from ( SELECT P.FieldName as Name, p.FieldValue as Value, NULL as LookupObjectType, NULL as LookupObjectID, NULL as LookupDisplayFormat, cast(0 as bit) as AllowMultipleValues FROM ( SELECT A.ObjectID as ID, CAST(TP.TextPath as nvarchar(max)) as TextPath FROM asset A cross apply dbo.GetAssetTextPathById(A.ID, '/') TP WHERE A.ObjectID = @valueint and A.[Object] = 'Taxonomy' ) A unpivot ( FieldValue for FieldName in (TextPath) ) p ) V end else if @LookupObjectType = 'ReferenceItem' and (CHARINDEX('#code#',@fieldlist) > 0) begin insert into @fieldValues select distinct V.Name, V.Value, V.LookupObjectType, V.LookupObjectID, V.LookupDisplayFormat, V.AllowMultipleValues from ( SELECT P.FieldName as Name, p.FieldValue as Value, NULL as LookupObjectType, NULL as LookupObjectID, NULL as LookupDisplayFormat, cast(0 as bit) as AllowMultipleValues FROM ( SELECT ObjectID as ID, CAST(Code as nvarchar(max)) as Code FROM Asset A WHERE A.ObjectID = @valueint and A.[Object] = 'ReferenceItem' ) A unpivot ( FieldValue for FieldName in (Code) ) p ) V end else if @LookupObjectType = 'ReferenceItemType' and (CHARINDEX('#name#',@fieldlist) > 0 or CHARINDEX('#description#',@fieldlist) > 0) begin insert into @fieldValues select distinct V.Name, V.Value, V.LookupObjectType, V.LookupObjectID, V.LookupDisplayFormat, V.AllowMultipleValues from ( SELECT P.FieldName as Name, p.FieldValue as Value, NULL as LookupObjectType, NULL as LookupObjectID, NULL as LookupDisplayFormat, cast(0 as bit) as AllowMultipleValues FROM ( SELECT ObjectID as ID, CAST(Name as nvarchar(max)) as Name, CAST(Description as nvarchar(max)) as Description FROM AssetType A WHERE A.ObjectID = @valueint and A.[Object] = 'ReferenceItemType' ) A unpivot ( FieldValue for FieldName in (Name, Description) ) p ) V end else if @LookupObjectType = 'Resource' and (CHARINDEX('#firstname#',@fieldlist) > 0 or CHARINDEX('#lastname#',@fieldlist) > 0 or CHARINDEX('#email#',@fieldlist) > 0) begin insert into @fieldValues select distinct V.Name, V.Value, V.LookupObjectType, V.LookupObjectID, V.LookupDisplayFormat, V.AllowMultipleValues from ( SELECT P.FieldName as Name, p.FieldValue as Value, NULL as LookupObjectType, NULL as LookupObjectID, NULL as LookupDisplayFormat, cast(0 as bit) as AllowMultipleValues FROM ( SELECT ResourceID as ID, CAST(FirstName as nvarchar(max)) as FirstName, CAST(LastName as nvarchar(max)) as LastName, CAST(Email as nvarchar(max)) as Email FROM reporting.Global_Resource A WHERE A.ResourceID = @valueint ) A unpivot ( FieldValue for FieldName in (FirstName, LastName, Email) ) p ) V end
declare @current int, @max int
set @current = 1 select @max = Max(ID) from @tokens
set @formattedValue = @DisplayFormat
while(@current <= @max) begin declare @currentToken nvarchar(100) = null, @currentField nvarchar(100) = null, @currentValue nvarchar(max) = null, @lkpType nvarchar(250) = null, @lkpID int = null, @lkpFormat nvarchar(250) = null, @allowMultiple bit = 0
select @currentField = Field, @currentToken = Token from @tokens where ID = @current
select top 1 @currentValue = Value, @lkpType = LookupObjectType, @lkpID = LookupObjectID, @lkpFormat = LookupDisplayFormat, @allowMultiple = AllowMultipleValues from @fieldValues where Field = @currentField
if @currentValue is not null begin if @lkpType is not null and @lkpID is not null begin select @currentValue = COALESCE(utility.GetFormattedFieldLookupValueWithMultiple(@Type, @lkpFormat, @lkpType, @lkpID, @currentValue, @allowMultiple), '') end
SET @formattedValue = REPLACE(@formattedValue, @currentToken, @currentValue) end else begin SET @formattedValue = REPLACE(@formattedValue, @currentToken, '') end
SET @current = @current + 1 end end end
return @formattedValue END
